definition: G(d) = equal-weight mean of frozen F_right(d), F_up(d), F_left(d), F_down(d)
interpolation: strict monotone piecewise linear; no clipping or extrapolation
vector_construction: if r>0 and inverse valid: b_cal=(q/r)*b; hypot(b_cal)=q; radial amplitude normalization, not a fitted 2x2 component calibration
historical_benchmark: Existing offline scores use X-equivalent reference, not this G; no new empirical performance score produced
noise: 20 uT assumed raw magnitude scale; locally transforms by G_slope/F_theta_slope, not a universal calibrated pass threshold
